notes.title: PATCH #5: 0.47.0
notes.notes:
FEATURE IMPROVEMENTS
BARRACKS


 Added "Speed Up" button in Barracks, when clicked it willl instantly call all 4 Units, instead of 1 at a time.
 Added Keyword Description Boxes to Barracks when mousing over a Unit.
BUILD MODE

 Greyed out Cards in Build Mode will now correctly display their Ability Info Box when the player mouses over the greyed out card

notes.title: PATCH #4: 0.46.0
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURE
Added 2x Zoom as default view. Use Mouse Scroll Wheel during a Match to swap between 2x and the original 1x. The game will save which zoom level you last left in your previous Match for your next Match.

BUGS

 Captain: Bandit Astrid's passive Ability was not working with Ninja, now it does
 Fixed Full Screen toggle in Options Menu not saving when changing from Windowed to Full Screen
 Fixed some Lava and Snow Battlefield tiles from locking up upon Match start
 Fixed "End Turn" graphic from not displaying during Tutorial

UNITS

 Rogue  - Base Power changed from 2 to 1 
 Units Bilge Rat, Fenix and Prowler were incorrectly counting their +1 Gold from their own Unit. This should now correctly only count other Units.
 Gunslinger - Text Updated - "Single Use, Snipe: Attack a nonadjacent 3 Power or less Enemy anywhere."

notes.title: PATCH #3: 0.45.0
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURE
Friendly Matches have been enabled. You can now play directly against others in your Steam's Friend List.

Or join our Discord and make a new buddy to battle against. 

https://www.discord.gg/castlehold

notes.title: HOTFIX: 0.44.1
notes.notes:
Tutorial Polish and Soft Lock Fixes
Reroll Currents (gems) Fix

notes.title: PATCH #2: 0.44.0
notes.notes:
TUTORIAL

 Training AI difficulty has been reduced

BUGS

 Barracks "Recall Unit" - Fixed a bug preventing you from spending Currents (gems) you've purchased to Recall a Unit
 Sound Effects - All VO, Button Clicks, Jingles will correctly lower if using "Effects" volume slider
 Fixed an issue where quickly Conceding a Match would sometimes not report the Match Resuts
 Paragon Icon now displays correctly
 Stage 2 Tutorial Visual Bug Fixed

UNIT CHANGES

 Rogue - "Deploy: Deploy Directly onto an Empty Village" 
 Governor - Changed Unit's Ability Power from "If Frosted gain +5 Power" to "gain +4 Power"
 Cybermancer - Change Unit's Base Power from 7 Power to 6 Power
 Swift Runner - Bug - Was sometimes being counted as a 0 Cost Unit when she is a 1 Cost.
 Ninja - Text Updated - "Single Use: Move up to 2 Spaces on the Turn after Deployment"
 Gold Card - Text Updated - "Gain +1 Gold this Turn to Deploy a Unit"
 Gunslinger - "Single Use, Snipe: Snipe a nonadjacent 3 Power or less Enemy anywhere." (Additionally, if Gunslinger's Power Rating is changed, then his Ability Power and text will reflect that Power change.)

The following Units have been updated to be able to use thier Ability OR Move in a single Turn (but not both).

 Marauder
 Maquis
 Freedom Fighter
 General

notes.title: PATCH #1: 0.43.0
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY

 Player 2 now recieves a "1+ Gold Card" which they deploy at any Turn. Note: The Gold Card acts a a deploy and will not allow Unit movement, only to deploy another Unit.


LEVELING REWARDS

 Currents (Gems) Level Reward increased to 60 Currents from 30.


UNIT UPDATES

 Sheriff - Deploy, Snipe: Send an Enemy backwards 1 space on the Battlefield (if available). (1 Gold, 2 Power)
 Ninja - Single Use: Move up to 2 Spaces (1 Gold, 2 Power)
 Outlaw - (2 Gold, 3 Power)
 Magi Seer - (1 Gold, 1 Power)
 Rogue - (1 Gold, 2 Power)

CAPTAIN UPDATES
[olist]
 Agent Luther - Allied Units with base 1 Power gain +1 Power (down from 2)
[/olist]

BUGS

 Quest Timer not displaying correct time properly after reset, now displays correctly.
 Fixed exploit allowing Army Builder to place more than 2 of the same Unit in your Army


PEFORMANCE

 Temporarily Removed "Title Screen Scene" and replaced wtih Static Background while we fix the peformance of the scene.
